item.title: Ohara & Sanzen-in: Kyoto's Tranquil Mountain Temple Village — Guide
item.description: Ohara is a quiet farming valley in the mountains an hour north of central Kyoto, a world away from the crowds and a favourite escape for those wanting the old, rural Kyoto. Its centrepiece is Sanzen-in, a serene monzeki temple set among cedar and maple, whose most famous view is a garden of deep green moss dotted with small, smiling stone jizo figures half-hidden in the undergrowth. In autumn the maples turn the whole valley to fire.
